meta.title: Races & Characters · TBD MMO design wiki
meta.description: The four playable races and the notable characters of the world.

intro.lede: Four races can be chosen at character creation. Who they are, where they come from and what they want is still to be designed.

races.title: Playable races
races.subtitle: Portraits will be added by the team
races.p1: Origins, culture and place in the world are not written.
races.p2: The racial and factional shape of the world is an open question in Cosmology. A Lineage 2-style multi-faction landscape is the working assumption.

characters.title: Notable characters
characters.subtitle: Quest-givers, antagonists, vendors and flavour
characters.tbd: No characters are written. Each notable character will get a role, one line on who they are, where they can be found, and a sentence on how they talk.
